top_issues: Breakdown chips (On-chain 0 / Reserve 40 / Secured 0 / Hub promise 122.99) do not reconcile with the ACCOUNTS card '+95.00 owes you' — Maya cannot see where the 122.99 lives.
'Move' and 'Show 1 empty' float in the BALANCES header row with no button affordance; the small bar under the total is unlabeled; lower-left third is dead space.
fixes: Make the hub-promise chip tap through to the H1 account and show 'of which H1 +95.00, WETH lane +27.99' inline so the two numbers tie.
Give 'Move'/'Show 1 empty' a pill border and chevron; add a 1-line caption 'bar = your balance at 1px=$1' under the total.

top_issues: Route card microcopy 'forwards atomically · fee 0.000025 of 0.000050 total' is unreadable at a glance and the per-hop split is unexplained.
Full 40-char hex in the To field is noise for Maya; the 'Change' link next to 'Instant' delivery is ambiguous (change delivery? change route?).
fixes: Render fee as '0.00005 USDC (0.00002 to H1)' with the raw figure behind a tooltip; default the To field to the resolved name 'H2' with the hex collapsed.
Rename the 'Change' link to 'Change route' and move it under the 2 ROUTES selector.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:36:11  in 8s' — the green 'in 8s' tag reads as a countdown, not a completion latency.
Proof hash is truncated with no expand/copy affordance, so Sofia cannot forward verifiable evidence from here.
fixes: Relabel as 'settled in 8s' with no status dot, or move it to a right-aligned 'latency 8s'.
Add a copy icon on the Proof row and an 'open in explorer / verify' link.

top_issues: '45.50 capacity via H1' is crammed into the top-right of the Amount field where it reads as a placeholder, not a constraint.
YOUR ENTITY ID block is a wall of hex with no copy button, while the three 'Copy …' buttons above it are visually identical.
fixes: Move capacity to a helper line under the amount: 'max you can receive right now: 45.50'.
Add a copy icon to the entity id and de-emphasize 'Copy xln:// app link' (tertiary) so the two primary copies stand out.

top_issues: Flow dead-ends: red 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' + disabled primary + an enabled 'Accept it as credit instead' — Anya cannot tell which is the safe path.
Order-book depth bars are scaled to the largest row, contradicting the product's ONE absolute-scale rule and reading as fake money bars.
Over-precision and broken-looking zeros: '2,500.5000 USDC per WETH', 'up to 0.0000 WETH', '0.039191 WETH more'.
fixes: Collapse the collateral slider + 3 presets + credit button into one decision card with a single recommended action and a 'why' tooltip; lift the disabled-button contrast.
Label book bars 'size' explicitly or drop them; cap displayed precision to 4 sig figs and show '0.0000' as '<0.0001'.

top_issues: Vocabulary drift: home says 'owes you' and 'hub promise', here 'they owe you', desk says 'at risk' — same number, three names.
'send up to 130.00' vs 'Your credit line to them 115.50' vs 'Collateral 60.00' — the math tying these is never shown, so Tomasz's 30s risk read fails.
fixes: Pick one canonical label per concept and reuse it everywhere (e.g. 'owed to you', 'at risk', 'secured by collateral').
Add a one-line derivation under the bar: 'send 130 = 70 owed + 60 collateral; you may extend 115.50 more on credit'.

top_issues: The tiny bar under each row reads as a progress/loading indicator, not an amount at the absolute scale — Ravi mis-scans the list.
'Swap filed' vs 'Swap placed' are two names for one event type.
fixes: Remove the per-row amount bar (the number already carries magnitude) or add a hover tooltip 'bar = 25.00 at 1px=$1'.
Standardize on 'Swap placed' / 'Swap filled'.

top_issues: With no row selected the entire right column is empty — the desktop layout looks broken at 1440px.
Same ambiguous row bars as 07.
fixes: Show a default 'this month' summary (count, net flow, on-chain vs hub split) in the right column when nothing is selected.
Apply the row-bar fix from 07.

top_issues: '1 px = $1' appears twice (top-right and after the slider); the long single column buries the VAULT danger zone far from the top.
'Reveal recovery phrase' sits unconfirmed beside 'Forget vault' — one mis-tap leaks the seed.
fixes: Show the scale value once, as the slider's live readout; group HOME/APPEARANCE/DESIGN in two columns to shorten the page.
Require a hold-to-confirm or password step on 'Reveal recovery phrase' and visually separate it from 'Forget vault'.

top_issues: WHAT HAPPENS shows a single radio 'Fund you through H1' for a Reserve→Account move — the label is wrong and the radio implies a choice that isn't there.
The FROM/TO cards' internal bars are too small to encode anything at this scale.
fixes: Replace the radio with a plain outcome sentence and a 'post on-chain collateral → instant' step list; only show a selector when >1 outcome exists.
Drop the micro-bars inside the lane cards; show the balance number only.

top_issues: Five flat identical tiles read as a settings menu, not a hub — weak premium/visceral value.
'Promised by hubs 97.99' here vs 'Hub promise 122.99' on home vs 'at risk 97.99' on desk: same idea, three labels and two numbers.
fixes: Add an icon-weight and a one-line exposure figure to each tile; give the grid a header with the account count.
Lock the three labels to one canonical term and one live number.

top_issues: The swap collateral slider is duplicated onto the faucet panel — two unrelated flows share a complex widget.
Faucet grid mixes ecosystems (USDC/WETH vs TRX/SUN) with no network grouping; 'Depository may pull 0.00' repeats as noise on every row.
fixes: Replace the right-column slider with a single 'receive into: [account ▾]' selector; keep collateral math only on Swap.
Group faucet tokens by network and hide the 'may pull' line when 0.00.

top_issues: Pool is 0/0/0 so the whole screen is a dead end with a disabled CTA and no 'why'.
No risk disclosure for lending to a hub — Kenji cannot see that principal is hub-credit, not collateral-backed.
fixes: When pool is empty, replace the form with an explainer + 'become first lender' framing and show expected yield.
Add a one-line risk chip: 'principal is a hub promise (at risk) — see Sovereignty'.

top_issues: ~70% of the canvas is empty; the only content is a 4-row board card.
Body text promises 'Register it on the EntityProvider to issue shares or change owners' but no such action button exists.
fixes: Add the described 'Register entity / Issue shares' primary action and a threshold-edit affordance.
Fill the right column with a board members / signature-policy summary even when it's 1-of-1.

top_issues: PER COUNTERPARTY text runs to the card edge and clips ('…you in 1 d · open → Manage → Dispute').
'Collateral behind what you are owed 0.00' contradicts the 60.00 collateral shown on the account screen.
fixes: Wrap the counterparty description and move the 'open → Manage → Dispute' path to a button.
Reconcile collateral figures to one source of truth across screens.

top_issues: Table numbers are ragged ('+70.00','0.01','0.00','130.00·45.50') — decimal columns don't align, killing Marcus's at-a-glance scan.
The '·' separator is used for both send·receive and lane labels, so 'Reserve·on-chain' and '130.00·45.50' parse the same way.
fixes: Right-align and tabular-numeral every numeric column; pad to a fixed decimal count.
Use '→' for send/receive pairs and '·' only for labels.

top_issues: Right-aligned grey descriptions ('dense console','on-chain wallet, faucets, debts') are below the contrast floor on the dimmed backdrop.
No grouping/recents; a long flat list forces scanning for the obvious Pay/Receive.
fixes: Raise description color to ~70% white and shrink font only slightly.
Add section headers (Money / Accounts / Admin) and a 'recent' row.

overall.verdict: A genuinely distinctive, premium self-custody wallet — the absolute-scale bars, sovereignty framing and provable-route pay flow are real differentiators that beat most crypto UIs on trust and visceral value. It is held back from 'strong' by terminology drift across screens, low-contrast microcopy, amount-bars that read as progress indicators, and several dead-end/empty states (swap, lending, ownership, activity-detail) that break the one-canonical-path feel on wide desktop.
priority_fixes: Unify vocabulary: one canonical label per concept ('owed to you', 'at risk', 'secured by collateral') reused verbatim on home, account, manage, sovereignty and desk — today the same number is 'hub promise', 'they owe you', 'promised by hubs' and 'at risk'.

Stop using absolute-scale amount bars as row underlines in Activity and as micro-bars inside Move/Account cards; they read as loading/progress. Reserve bars for the balance/credit visualizations and add a one-time '1px=$1' legend.
Raise the contrast floor on grey microcopy (send up to / receive up to / 'Show 1 empty' / palette descriptions / 'Depository may pull 0.00') and fix clipped text on the Sovereignty counterparty card.

Repair the dead-end flows: swap (red error + disabled primary + credit button = no clear next step), lending (empty pool with no explanation), ownership (promised Register/Issue action missing). Each needs one recommended action and a 'why'.
Fill empty desktop right-columns (activity-detail, ownership, manage bottom) with a default summary or next action, and tabular-align the Desk table numbers so Marcus can scan exposure at a glance.
